translations.web: to God our Savior, who alone is wise, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and forever. Amen.
translations.bsb: to the only God our Savior be glory, majesty, dominion, and authority through Jesus Christ our Lord before all time, and now, and for all eternity. Amen.
translations.kjv: To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.
translations.asv: to the only God our Saviour, through Jesus Christ our Lord, be glory, majesty, dominion and power, before all time, and now, and for evermore. Amen.
